title: Observability Extension Queries Configuration
description: Configuration schema for custom Prometheus queries in the GNOME Observability extension

$schema.description: Path or URL to the JSON schema

metrics.description: List of Prometheus metrics to query and display

dropdown_label.description: Display label shown in the dropdown menu

topbar_label.description: Short display label shown in the top bar status area

promql.description: PromQL query to execute against the Prometheus API

unit.description: Measurement unit appended to the value (e.g. '%', 'GB', 'ms')

show_in_topbar.description: Whether to display this metric directly in the GNOME Shell top bar

icon.description: Freedesktop / GNOME symbolic icon name for this metric
